strip.toggleOffDescription: Run this session in its own Git worktree so parallel agents do not disturb each other.
strip.toggleOnDescription: Running in an isolated worktree at {{path}}. Turn off to run in the project directory.
strip.togglePendingOnDescription: Worktree isolation is armed. The worktree will be created after you send the first message.
strip.togglePendingOffDescription: Worktree isolation will be turned off after you send the first message.
strip.toggleLocked: Worktree isolation can only be changed before the session's first message.
strip.dispatchBaseline: Remote tasks run in an isolated copy. This cannot be changed after you select a target.
strip.retained: The worktree still held local work and was kept at {{path}}.

settings.title: Worktrees
settings.description: Defaults used when a session runs in its own Git worktree. Paths are resolved on the current execution host; root changes affect new worktrees only.
settings.required: The root path and branch prefix are required.

isolation.title: Session isolation
isolation.description: Sessions run in the project directory by default. The worktree toggle next to the branch moves a session into its own checkout.

rootPath.label: Worktree root
rootPath.description: New worktrees are stored under this directory on the current execution host.

branchPrefix.label: Branch prefix
branchPrefix.description: Suggested prefix when creating a branch for a detached worktree.

copyChanges.label: Copy local changes by default
copyChanges.description: Off by default. Copies uncommitted project changes into the new worktree, preserving staging.

autoDelete.label: Automatically delete old worktrees
autoDelete.description: After creating a worktree, OpenBitFun removes the oldest managed worktrees beyond the workspace limit when they are safe to delete.

autoDeleteLimit.label: Auto-delete limit
autoDeleteLimit.description: Managed worktrees to keep per workspace. Worktrees with associated conversations, local changes, unpublished commits, or Git locks are always kept.

management.title: Workspace worktrees
management.description: Worktrees under the configured OpenBitFun root on the current execution host, grouped by owning workspace.
management.loadFailed: Could not load the OpenBitFun worktree list.

empty.title: No OpenBitFun worktrees
empty.description: Worktrees created for isolated sessions will appear here.

sessions.title: Conversations
sessions.openFailed: Could not open this conversation. Refresh the list and try again.
sessions.restoreMessage: {{name}} is archived. Restore it before opening?

protection.locked: Unlock this worktree in Git before deleting it.
protection.missing: The worktree directory is missing. Clean up the stale Git record manually.

delete.title: Delete this worktree?
delete.message: The checkout will be removed. This action cannot be undone.
delete.messageWithSessions: The checkout will be removed. Associated conversations stay in history, but their checkout will no longer be available.
delete.forceMessage: This worktree contains local changes or detached commits. Deleting it will permanently discard that local work.
delete.forceMessageWithSessions: Local changes or detached commits will be permanently discarded. Associated conversations stay in history without their checkout.

errors.locked: This worktree is locked by Git and cannot be deleted.
errors.dirty: This worktree still contains local changes.
errors.unpublishedCommits: This worktree still contains unpublished detached commits.
errors.notFound: This worktree no longer exists. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.remoteUnsupported: Remote SSH worktrees are not supported yet.
